q: How much does a job cost?
a: Pricing depends on the material, size and finish of the work, so we quote after seeing the opening or space. Measures and quotes are free — send your details or call and we will arrange a visit.
We serve Islamabad & Rawalpindi from our workshop at Fateh Jang Rd, E 18 Gulshan e Sehat, Islamabad. If you are just outside these areas, call us and we will let you know.

q: Do you handle repairs as well as new work?
a: Yes — adjustments, glass replacement, hardware fixes and repairs to existing aluminium, glass and wood units. Call or WhatsApp with a description and, if possible, a photo.

q: How long does an order take?
a: Timelines vary with material availability and the size of the job. You will get a clear timeline with your quote, and we will keep you updated through fabrication and fitting.
